assign.brief: Owner, on /framework/ux/Dictate/ (2026-10-01): wants a NEW mode, kept alongside today's default (do not nuke the current dictate UX, which works well) — owner's words: 'like clean transcription mode or something where instead of writing into this text area, we just do the same thing in the chat bubble where it's going to be sent.' Today, clean-transcription mode (revise: "clean", ext/Chat/Composer.js's ComposerMic) writes the clean revised text INTO the composer box, then it autosends after a pause (dictate mode). The owner wants a variant that skips the intermediate step of showing/writing text into the composer box at all — a finished sentence goes straight to being a chat bubble (the way old mode:"open" used to send straight through with nothing written into $input, per ux/Dictate/readme.md), but using the CURRENT clean-revision pipeline (ux/Revise) rather than raw text. Scope this as a new named row in Widget.js's MODES table (same pattern as "dictate"/"chat"), not a parallel system — CLAUDE.md law 6, one of everything. Read public/framework/ux/Dictate/readme.md (Widget, chat.js, Revise sections) and public/framework/ext/Chat/readme.md first. Propose the exact mode name and mechanics as a short decision (Server/decide.mjs) before building, then implement it as an opt-in mode, verify, and land per finish-task.

Chose 'live': Widget.js gets one new MODES row, `live: { into: "chat", bubble: true }`, that turns on the EXACT 'Live bubbles' feature ext/Chat/readme.md already documents for ChatPanel (Mic.js's own SETTINGS.into default) by finally passing `on_live` from Widget.Composer — a sentence grows straight into a chat bubble, never the text box, reusing ComposerMic's existing ghost-box/show_live mechanism with zero new transport. Rejected 'clean': already means revise:"clean" sitewide (the gear's 'clean transcription' checkbox, ComposerMic.clean_active()) — a mode named 'clean' would collide with that unrelated, existing meaning and break 'pick names that can't be misread'. Rejected 'speak': accurate (voice-first) but doesn't say the one thing that makes this mode different, that it skips the box — 'live' names the actual mechanism being turned on. Confidence 0.85. mode and revision stay orthogonal, same as the existing dictate/chat rows: mode picks WHERE words land, revision (separate, pre-existing Widget option) picks WHAT they say — pair `mode:"live"` with `revision:"clean"` to get what the owner asked for.
